name: Kashiwazaki Kahoruko
source:
Occupation: Volunteer Department
Role: Honjin Defense

Kashiwazaki's magical girl identity. Protects the main volunteer department's main line of defense. Utilizes various "Magic Tools" in battles.

Her magical ability is "Mahou no Dougu" (魔法の道具).
